_comment: Claude Code adapter: install to .claude/settings.json (practice `session-bootstrap`). Wires the SessionStart hook (which execs tools/bootstrap.sh), a PreToolUse hook that surfaces the path-triggered loading channel's matched practice Rules before an Edit/Write/NotebookEdit proceeds, a Stop hook that blocks ending a turn with uncommitted/untracked/unpushed work, and allowlists the routine safe commands sessions run constantly, so work doesn't stall on permission prompts. Add your repo's own audit/build commands. The Precedent loader commands are listed BOTH bare and with arguments: Claude Code matches `Bash(cmd *)` against an invocation that actually has arguments, so a bare `python3 tools/doc_lint.py` -- the exact form the merge runbook and AGENTS.md's own light check tell every session to run -- prompted on every single run until both forms were listed. ALSO WIRED, since 2026-09-06: freshness-guard.sh twice (a SessionStart pass that fetches and fast-forwards when that is provably lossless, and a PreToolUse gate that refuses the session's first tool call on a checkout it cannot vouch for), and commit-identity.sh, which resolves whoever is running the session and installs a pre-commit hook refusing a commit authored by the container's own bot account. REPLACE THE BASE BRANCH ARGUMENT (`main` below) with this repo's real base branch -- it is passed explicitly because asking git for the default branch gets it wrong in at least one real repo. The PreToolUse matcher for the guard includes Bash on purpose: an agent editing files through cat/sed/python3 never touches Edit or Write at all. The env block's TZ is a stated DEFAULT for people who have declared no timezone anywhere; a person whose individual practice source declares one gets that instead, enforced by the pre-commit hook.
